discription: A classic Frequency Modulation (FM) synthesizer patch with an ADSR envelope. It uses a sine wave carrier modulated by another sine wave.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, ratio=1.5, index=5, att=0.01, dec=0.1, sus=0.8, rel=1.0; var sig, env; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(att, dec, sus, rel, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = SinOsc.ar( freq * (1 + (SinOsc.ar(freq * ratio) * index)) ) * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
